'''Science and technology'''
*[[Solar eclipse of October 2, 2024]]
**The annular solar eclipse of October 2, 2024 is seen over much of Pacific Ocean today; the last eclipse to occur during the same day since [[solar eclipse of October 2, 1978]] and until [[October 2107 lunar eclipse]] in 2107. [https://eclipsewise.com/solar/SEprime/2001-2100/SE2024Oct02Aprime.html (EclipseWise)]
